#IAT
```{r}
ability <- IAT_data_D2$ability_IAT
moral   <- IAT_data_D2$moral_IAT

# Ability
t_ability  <- t.test(ability, mu = 0)
d_ability  <- cohens_d(ability, mu = 0)
bf_ability <- ttestBF(x = ability, mu = 0)

# Moral
t_moral  <- t.test(moral, mu = 0)
d_moral  <- cohens_d(moral, mu = 0)
bf_moral <- ttestBF(x = moral, mu = 0)

# 输出
t_ability; d_ability; bf_ability
t_moral;   d_moral;   bf_moral
```

# 可视化
```{r}

plot_data <- data.frame(
  domain = factor(c("competence", "morality"),
                  levels = c("competence", "morality")),
  mean = c(mean(IAT_data_D2$moral_IAT, na.rm = TRUE),
           mean(IAT_data_D2$ability_IAT, na.rm = TRUE)),
  sd = c(sd(IAT_data_D2$moral_IAT, na.rm = TRUE),
         sd(IAT_data_D2$ability_IAT, na.rm = TRUE)),
  n = c(sum(!is.na(IAT_data_D2$moral_IAT)),
        sum(!is.na(IAT_data_D2$ability_IAT)))
)

# 标准误
plot_data$se <- plot_data$sd / sqrt(plot_data$n)

# 95% CI
plot_data$ci <- qt(.975, df = plot_data$n - 1) * plot_data$se
library(ggplot2)

# 计算 95% CI
plot_data$ci <- qt(.975, df = plot_data$n - 1) * plot_data$se



p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = domain, y = mean)) +
  
  # 柱子（低饱和学术色，无重边框）
  geom_col(width = 0.3,
           fill = c("grey70", "grey70"),
           color = NA) +
  
  # 95% CI 误差线（更细）
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - ci,
                    ymax = mean + ci),
                width = 0.1,
                linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  # 零基线
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 0.4) +
  
  
  # 纵轴范围（给顶部留空间）
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 0.62),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "D Score"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = "Arial") +
  
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p


ggsave(

  plot = p,
  width = 4.5,
  height = 2.25,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,

)
```

# SMT
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 1. 从原始数据计算 d-prime (ALT2_0)
ALT2_0 <- ALT2_all %>%
  # 排除无效试次
  filter(!is.na(correct)) %>%
  group_by(ID, domain, valence, person) %>%
  # 标记信号检测论的分类
  mutate(sdt = case_when(
    (correct == 1 & identity == 'match') ~ "hit",
    (correct == 1 & identity == 'nonmatch') ~ "CR",
    (correct == 0 & identity == 'match') ~ "miss",
    (correct == 0 & identity == 'nonmatch') ~ "FA"
  )) %>%
  # 统计频数
  summarize(
    hit = sum(sdt == "hit"),
    miss = sum(sdt == "miss"),
    FA = sum(sdt == "FA"),
    CR = sum(sdt == "CR"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # 计算比率并进行标准校正 (防止 0 或 1 导致 Inf)
  mutate(
    hitR = hit / (hit + miss),
    FAR  = FA / (FA + CR),
    hitR = ifelse(hitR == 1, 1 - 1/(2*(hit + miss)), hitR),
    FAR  = ifelse(FAR == 0, 1/(2*(hit + miss)), FAR),
    # 计算 d-prime
    dprime = qnorm(hitR) - qnorm(FAR)
  )

# 2. 准备用于贝叶斯分析的长格式数据 (确保变量类型正确)
bf_data <- ALT2_0 %>%
  mutate(across(c(ID, domain, valence, person), as.factor))
```

# SMT d
```{r}
ALT_diff <- ALT2_0 %>%
  select(ID, domain, valence, person, dprime) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = person,
              values_from = dprime) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(diff = self - friend)
```
```{r}
test_alt_advantage <- function(data, dom, val){

  temp <- data %>%
    filter(domain == dom,
           valence == val)

  diff_values <- na.omit(temp$diff)

  cat("\n==============================\n")
  cat("ALT | Domain:", dom,
      "| Valence:", val, "\n")
  cat("Valid N =", length(diff_values), "\n")

  if(length(diff_values) < 2){
    cat("⚠ Not enough valid observations\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  t_res <- t.test(diff_values, mu = 0)
  print(t_res)

 d_res <- effectsize::cohens_d(
  diff_values,
  mu = 0,
  paired = FALSE,
  ci = 0.95
)

print(d_res)

  bf <- BayesFactor::ttestBF(
    x = diff_values,
    mu = 0
  )
  print(bf)
}
```

```{r}
test_alt_advantage(ALT_diff, "ability",  "positive")
test_alt_advantage(ALT_diff, "ability",  "negative")
test_alt_advantage(ALT_diff, "moral", "positive")
test_alt_advantage(ALT_diff, "moral", "negative")
```

# SMT rt
```{r}
ALT_rt_mean <- ALT2_all %>%
  group_by(ID, domain, valence, person) %>%
  summarise(rt = mean(rt, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# 2️⃣ self − friend
ALT_rt_diff <- ALT_rt_mean %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = person,
              values_from = rt) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(diff = self - friend)

test_rt_advantage <- function(data, dom, val){

  temp <- data %>%
    filter(domain == dom,
           valence == val)

  diff_values <- na.omit(temp$diff)

  cat("\n==============================\n")
  cat("RT | Domain:", dom,
      "| Valence:", val, "\n")
  cat("Valid N =", length(diff_values), "\n")

  if(length(diff_values) < 2){
    cat("⚠ Not enough valid observations\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  t_res <- t.test(diff_values, mu = 0)
  print(t_res)

 d_res <- effectsize::cohens_d(
  diff_values,
  mu = 0,
  paired = FALSE,
  ci = 0.95
)

print(d_res)

  bf <- BayesFactor::ttestBF(
    x = diff_values,
    mu = 0
  )
  print(bf)
}
```
```{r}
test_rt_advantage(ALT_rt_diff, "ability",  "positive")
test_rt_advantage(ALT_rt_diff, "ability",  "negative")
```

# SRET
```{r}
SRET_EW <- function(data){

  SRET_EW <- data %>%
    mutate( 
      ID = factor(ID),      
      person = factor(person),
      valence = factor(valence),
      domain = factor(domain),
      rt = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rt)),
      correct = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(correct))
  ) %>%
    filter(screen_id %in% c("EW_formal")) %>%
    filter(!word %in% c("务实", "迷糊", "坚贞", "说谎", "主见", "缓慢", "素养", "低俗")) %>%
    group_by(ID, person, valence, domain) %>%
    summarize(
      N_Yes = sum(responses == "yes"),
      N_No  = sum(responses == "no"),
      N = n(),
      pro_yes = N_Yes,
      avg_rt = mean(rt, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_rt = sd(rt, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  print(SRET_EW)
  print(describe(SRET_EW))
  return(SRET_EW)
}
```


```{r}
library(psych)
SRET_EW_df <- SRET_EW(SRET)
```


#ew
```{r}
# ability × positive 下的 self 优势
dat_ability_pos <- SRET_EW_df %>%
  filter(domain == "ability", valence == "Positive") %>%
  group_by(ID, person) %>%
  summarise(pro_yes = mean(pro_yes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = person, values_from = pro_yes) %>%
  drop_na(any_of(c("self", "friend")))

# 2. 传统频率分析 (Paired t-test)
t_test_ability_pos <- t.test(
  dat_ability_pos$self, 
  dat_ability_pos$friend, 
  paired = TRUE
)

# 3. 计算效应量 Cohen's d (推荐使用 lsr 包)
# library(lsr)
d_ability_pos <- lsr::cohensD(
  dat_ability_pos$self, 
  dat_ability_pos$friend, 
  method = "paired"
)

# 4. 原有的贝叶斯因素分析
bf_ability_pos <- ttestBF(
  x = dat_ability_pos$self,
  y = dat_ability_pos$friend,
  paired = TRUE
)

# --- 打印结果汇总 ---
cat("\n--- 传统频率分析结果 (Frequentist) ---\n")
print(t_test_ability_pos)
cat("Cohen's d (效应量):", d_ability_pos, "\n")

cat("\n--- 贝叶斯分析结果 (Bayesian) ---\n")
print(bf_ability_pos)
```

```{r}
cat("\n--- 贝叶斯分析结果 (Bayesian) ---\n")
print(bf_moral_pos)
```

```{r}
library(BayesFactor)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

test_self_advantage <- function(data, domain_name, valence_name){

  dat <- data %>%
    filter(domain == domain_name,
           valence == valence_name) %>%
    select(ID, person, pro_yes) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = person,
                values_from = pro_yes) %>%
    drop_na(self, friend)
# 2. 传统频率分析 (Paired t-test)
  t_res <- t.test(dat$self, dat$friend, paired = TRUE)
  
# 3. 计算效应量 Cohen's d
  d_res <- effectsize::cohens_d(
    dat$self,
    dat$friend,
    paired = TRUE,
    ci = 0.95
  )
  # 4.bf
  bf <- ttestBF(
    x = dat$self,
    y = dat$friend,
    paired = TRUE
  )
# ----------------------------
  # 打印结果
  # ----------------------------

  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat(sprintf("Domain: %s | Valence: %s\n", domain_name, valence_name))
  cat(sprintf("N = %d\n", nrow(dat)))
  cat("------------------------------------------------------------\n")

  cat(sprintf("Self:   M = %.3f, SD = %.3f\n",
              mean(dat$self), sd(dat$self)))

  cat(sprintf("Friend: M = %.3f, SD = %.3f\n",
              mean(dat$friend), sd(dat$friend)))

  cat(sprintf("t(%d) = %.3f, p = %.3e\n",
              t_res$parameter,
              t_res$statistic,
              t_res$p.value))

  cat(sprintf("Cohen's dz = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f]\n",
              d_res$Cohens_d,
              d_res$CI_low,
              d_res$CI_high))

  cat(sprintf("Bayes Factor (BF10) = %.3f\n",
              extractBF(bf)$bf))

  cat("============================================================\n")

  return(list(
    t_test = t_res,
    cohen_d = d_res,
    bayes_factor = bf
  ))
}

# 运行分析
bf_ability_pos  <- test_self_advantage(SRET_EW_df, "ability",  "Positive")
bf_ability_neg  <- test_self_advantage(SRET_EW_df, "ability",  "Negative")
bf_moral_pos    <- test_self_advantage(SRET_EW_df, "morality", "Positive")
bf_moral_neg    <- test_self_advantage(SRET_EW_df, "morality", "Negative")

```

# rt
```{r}
test_self_advantage_rt <- function(data, domain_name, valence_name){

  dat <- data %>%
    filter(domain == domain_name,
           valence == valence_name) %>%
    select(ID, person, avg_rt) %>%      # ⚠️ 改这里
    pivot_wider(names_from = person,
                values_from = avg_rt) %>% # ⚠️ 改这里
    drop_na(self, friend)

  # 1. Paired t-test
  t_res <- t.test(dat$self, dat$friend, paired = TRUE)

  # 2. Cohen's dz + 95% CI
  d_res <- effectsize::cohens_d(
    dat$self,
    dat$friend,
    paired = TRUE,
    ci = 0.95
  )

  # 3. Bayes Factor
  bf <- ttestBF(
    x = dat$self,
    y = dat$friend,
    paired = TRUE
  )

  # ----------------------------
  # 打印结果
  # ----------------------------

  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat(sprintf("RT | Domain: %s | Valence: %s\n", domain_name, valence_name))
  cat(sprintf("N = %d\n", nrow(dat)))
  cat("------------------------------------------------------------\n")

  cat(sprintf("Self RT:   M = %.3f, SD = %.3f\n",
              mean(dat$self), sd(dat$self)))

  cat(sprintf("Friend RT: M = %.3f, SD = %.3f\n",
              mean(dat$friend), sd(dat$friend)))

  cat(sprintf("t(%d) = %.3f, p = %.3e\n",
              t_res$parameter,
              t_res$statistic,
              t_res$p.value))

  cat(sprintf("Cohen's dz = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f]\n",
              d_res$Cohens_d,
              d_res$CI_low,
              d_res$CI_high))

  cat(sprintf("Bayes Factor (BF10) = %.3f\n",
              extractBF(bf)$bf))

  cat("============================================================\n")

  return(list(
    t_test = t_res,
    cohen_d = d_res,
    bayes_factor = bf
  ))
}

# 运行 RT 分析
rt_ability_pos  <- test_self_advantage_rt(SRET_EW_df, "ability",  "Positive")
rt_ability_neg  <- test_self_advantage_rt(SRET_EW_df, "ability",  "Negative")
rt_moral_pos    <- test_self_advantage_rt(SRET_EW_df, "morality", "Positive")
rt_moral_neg    <- test_self_advantage_rt(SRET_EW_df, "morality", "Negative")
```

```{r}
rec_df <- SRET_update %>%
  mutate(
    sdt = case_when(
      identity == "old" & responses %in% c("old","familiar") ~ "hit",
      identity == "old" & responses == "new" ~ "miss",
      identity == "new" & responses %in% c("old","familiar") ~ "fa",
      identity == "new" & responses == "new" ~ "cr"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  group_by(ID, domain, valence, person) %>%
  
  summarise(
    H  = sum(sdt == "hit", na.rm = TRUE),
    M  = sum(sdt == "miss", na.rm = TRUE),
    FA = sum(sdt == "fa", na.rm = TRUE),
    CR = sum(sdt == "cr", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    P_H  = (H + 0.5) / (H + M + 1),
    P_FA = (FA + 0.5) / (FA + CR + 1),
    dprime = qnorm(P_H) - qnorm(P_FA)
  )
```
```{r}
rec_diff_df <- rec_df %>%
  select(ID, domain, valence, person, dprime) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = person,
    values_from = dprime
  ) %>%
  drop_na(self, friend) %>%
  mutate(
    diff = self - friend   # ⭐ 正值 = recognition自我优势
  )
```

```{r}
library(BayesFactor)

test_self_advantage_rec <- function(data, dom, val){

  temp <- data %>%
    filter(domain == dom, valence == val)

  cat("\n==============================\n")
  cat("Domain:", dom, "| Valence:", val, "\n")

  # -------------------
  # 1️⃣ 传统配对 t 检验
  # -------------------
  t_res <- t.test(temp$diff, mu = 0)

  print(t_res)

  # 计算 Cohen's d (单样本)
  d_value <- mean(temp$diff, na.rm = TRUE) /
             sd(temp$diff, na.rm = TRUE)

  cat("Cohen's d =", round(d_value, 3), "\n")

  # -------------------
  # 2️⃣ 贝叶斯 t 检验
  # -------------------
  bf <- ttestBF(
    x = temp$diff,
    mu = 0
  )

  print(bf)

  return(list(t_test = t_res,
              d = d_value,
              BF = bf))
}
```

```{r}
bf_rec_moral_neg   <- test_self_advantage_rec(rec_diff_df, "morality", "Negative")
```

```{r}
test_self_advantage_source <- function(data, dom, val){

  temp <- data %>%
    filter(domain == dom, valence == val)

  cat("\n==============================\n")
  cat("Source Stage | Domain:", dom,
      "| Valence:", val, "\n")

  # 1️⃣ 传统单样本 t 检验
  t_res <- t.test(temp$dprime, mu = 0)
  print(t_res)

  # 2️⃣ Cohen's d
  d_value <- mean(temp$dprime, na.rm = TRUE) /
             sd(temp$dprime, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("Cohen's d =", round(d_value, 3), "\n")

  # 3️⃣ 贝叶斯检验
  bf <- BayesFactor::ttestBF(
    x = temp$dprime,
    mu = 0
  )
  print(bf)
# 【新增】提取 95% 置信区间的值
  ci_lower <- t_res$conf.int[1]
  ci_upper <- t_res$conf.int[2]
  
  # 返回整洁结果
  tibble(
    Stage = "Source",
    Domain = dom,
    Valence = val,
    Mean_diff = mean(temp$dprime, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(temp$dprime, na.rm = TRUE),
    t = unname(t_res$statistic),
    df = unname(t_res$parameter),
    p = t_res$p.value,
    conf_low = ci_lower,  
    conf_high = ci_upper, 
    d = d_value,
    BF10 = as.vector(bf)
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

#==============================
# 1 IAT
#==============================

IAT_index <- IAT_data_D2 %>%
  select(ID, ability_IAT, moral_IAT)

#==============================
# 2 SMT d'
#==============================

SMT_d_index <- ALT_diff %>%
  group_by(ID, domain, valence) %>%
  summarise(diff = mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  unite(index, domain, valence) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = index, values_from = diff) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0("SMT_d_", .), -ID)

#==============================
# 3 SMT RT
#==============================

SMT_rt_index <- ALT_rt_diff %>%
  group_by(ID, domain, valence) %>%
  summarise(diff = mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  unite(index, domain, valence) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = index, values_from = diff) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0("SMT_rt_", .), -ID)

#==============================
# 4 SRET Encoding yes rate
#==============================

SRET_yes_index <- SRET_EW_df %>%
  group_by(ID, domain, valence) %>%
  summarise(pro_yes = mean(pro_yes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  unite(index, domain, valence) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = index, values_from = pro_yes) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0("SRET_yes_", .), -ID)

#==============================
# 5 SRET RT
#==============================

SRET_rt_index <- SRET_EW_df %>%
  group_by(ID, domain, valence) %>%
  summarise(avg_rt = mean(avg_rt, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  unite(index, domain, valence) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = index, values_from = avg_rt) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0("SRET_rt_", .), -ID)

#==============================
# 6 Recognition
#==============================

REC_index <- rec_df %>%
  select(ID, domain, valence, dprime) %>%
  unite(index, domain, valence) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = index,
    values_from = dprime,
    values_fn = mean  
  ) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0("REC_", .), -ID)

#==============================
# 7 Source memory
#==============================

SOURCE_index <- source_df %>%
  select(ID, domain, valence, dprime) %>%
  unite(index, domain, valence) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = index, values_from = dprime) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0("SOURCE_", .), -ID)

#==============================
# 合并所有指标
#==============================

index_26 <- IAT_index %>%
  left_join(SMT_d_index, by = "ID") %>%
  left_join(SMT_rt_index, by = "ID") %>%
  left_join(SRET_yes_index, by = "ID") %>%
  left_join(SRET_rt_index, by = "ID") %>%
  left_join(REC_index, by = "ID") %>%
  left_join(SOURCE_index, by = "ID")
```
